title: SourcedDirective
description: ITIP archetype — a Directive ascription whose statement is sourced from a legal/regulatory authority text. Extends Directive with legal provenance (source) and deployment guidance. All Directive fields (structure, modal, verb, qualifier, purpose) are inherited — not redefined. Source: ITIP (domain archetype for regulatory model sourcing).

source.description: Legal provenance — traceability chain to the authoritative legal text.

deploymentNotes.description: Guidance for resolving symbolic references and scoping at deployment time.
